declared: 2026-11-07, before the frozen rustc 1.98.0 oracle of these exact bytes. The drafts' lang-item and feature prerequisites were settled against rustc 1.98.0 in obj/parallel/census-batch5/repro first; each outcome follows the stated rule, not that exploration
amendments: 2026-11-07 after oracle v1 (obj/parallel/census-batch5/oracle/declaration-constant-execution.rustc-oracle.json, 9/9 agree): the pinned census 5 compiler already accepts implicit-discriminant-length, so it does not exercise the core `const _` failure, which is a layout read of an implicit-discriminant enum. v2 adds implicit-discriminant-layout, its mismatch opponent and projected-choice-length, each declared here before oracle v2; no v1 case or outcome changed.

bit-count-lengths.rs.reason: source ctpop, ctlz, cttz and their nonzero forms evaluate in array lengths at u8/u16/u32/i64 widths, including zero inputs to the total forms (8 and 32)

bit-count-mismatch.rs.reason: opponent: ctpop(0b1011_0110u8) is 5, so a [u8; 5] is not [u8; 4] (E0308)

bit-count-nonzero-zero.rs.reason: opponent: ctlz_nonzero(0u8) is undefined, so constant evaluation fails (E0080)

implicit-discriminant-length.rs.reason: a declaration-phase constant stores a fieldless enum with only implicit discriminants and matches on it, and casts another variant

implicit-discriminant-mismatch.rs.reason: opponent: Mode::Third as usize is 2, so a [u8; 2] is not [u8; 3] (E0308)

later-field-template.rs.reason: a const fn executed for an array length builds a struct declared later in source order

later-field-template-mismatch.rs.reason: opponent: the later struct's selected field is 3, so a [u8; 3] is not [u8; 2] (E0308)

later-associated-value.rs.reason: a scalar impl validated for an early length names a later-declared Copy struct as its associated type value

later-associated-value-not-copy.rs.reason: opponent: the later associated type value does not implement the required Copy (E0277)

implicit-discriminant-layout.rs.reason: size_of reads the layout of a generic enum with only implicit discriminants, declared after its uses, in a fn length and an unnamed const's annotation length (the core lib.rs `const _` shape)

implicit-discriminant-layout-mismatch.rs.reason: opponent: Choice<u8> has a one-byte tag and a u8 payload, so a [u8; 2] is not [u8; 1] (E0308)

projected-choice-length.rs.reason: a const fn executed for an array length stores an implicit-discriminant enum around a later-declared struct whose field is a projection through an impl's associated type
